name: com.taobao.accs.data.MsgDistributeService
description: When Umeng Agoo/ACCS delivers a message to the app, this Service routes it to Umeng Push's message handler and queues internal requests sent through the same channel.
disableEffect: Umeng Agoo/ACCS messages will no longer reach the app's push handler; the app's other features continue to work.
